evidence: Habitat indoor navigation; comparison to single-agent approaches and prior work; sample-efficiency gains, no numbers

evidence: Unspecified experiments across multiple datasets and models; 3-4% improvement over non-adaptive baselines; indicator-based profiling of uncertainty metrics
rationale: Question title answered by profiling and selection results. Consistent 3-4% gains stay within the reported, though unnamed, experiments.

evidence: S3DIS and ScanNetV2; outperforms recent state-of-the-art methods; no numbers

evidence: Unspecified series of experiments; better latent-space utilization; generative ability not harmed

evidence: CrossTask, COIN, NIV benchmarks; state-of-the-art performance; explainable visualizations
rationale: Acronym asserts state changes matter; SOTA on three named benchmarks with state-change modelling supports it. SOTA scoped to named benchmarks.

evidence: Unbiasedness-in-expectation result for a wide class of methods; unspecified large graph datasets; SOTA; efficiency vs existing GRL libraries
rationale: Scalability attribute supported by large-graph results. State-of-the-art claim rests on unnamed datasets, exceeding unspecified evidence.

evidence: Two unnamed ECG datasets; segmentation boosts classification; expert grading study of segmentation quality

evidence: Airline itinerary booking data; vs feature-engineered MNL, latent class MNL, recent ML approaches; accuracy and log loss
rationale: Descriptive title. 'Significantly outperforming' is unquantified but tied to a specific task and named baselines.

evidence: Unspecified experiments: last-layer retraining of DNNs under sub-population shifts with existing importance weighting techniques
rationale: 'Optimizing' read as the method's activity (weights are optimized). 'Significantly improves generalization' backed only by unspecified experiments.

evidence: Unspecified contemporary CNN architectures; high accuracy with frozen random filters; small gains from learning 3x3; gains grow with kernel size
rationale: Implicit 'power' title fits findings. Abstract attributes kernel-size trend to i.i.d. initialization without reported evidence.

evidence: Unspecified experiments; improved training times and accuracy vs shallow methods; generalizes some published single-purpose architectures
rationale: 'Towards General-Purpose' is tentative and matched by hedged, directional results; abstract claims remain modest.

evidence: Number of MSVs vs prediction accuracy across convolutional and transformer models; unspecified experiments
rationale: Question title addressed by MSV-accuracy relationship across model types; conclusion hedged with 'suggesting'.

evidence: Unspecified graphs; vs mathematical solvers and metaheuristics; competitive color counts, faster; generalization across graph types
rationale: 'Learn to Solve' treated like 'Learning to...'. 'Significantly faster' and 'generalizes well across graph types' rest on unspecified experiments.

evidence: CSQA, ARC, QASC, OBQA; up to ~3% and ~7% gains over best methods; low-data regime; KG completion

evidence: MM-based convergence guarantee; unspecified public benchmarks; outperforms SOTA matching/clustering methods in accuracy and efficiency
rationale: Convergent/flexible attributes backed by theory and design. SOTA outperformance claimed on unnamed public benchmarks.

evidence: Cell trajectory and perturbation-response tasks; image translation OT-FM vs UOT-FM; theoretical grounding; unspecified datasets
rationale: Improvement claim supported across several translation tasks and estimators; 'any estimator' is an applicability statement backed by theory.

evidence: Unspecified real-life time series classification datasets
rationale: Descriptive title. Directional effectiveness claim backed by unspecified experiments; no magnitude or SOTA claims.

evidence: Unspecified concrete examples; backends numpy, tensorflow, keras; GPU mode; unit tests
rationale: Descriptive title. 'The only package' unified-framework claim is sweeping; efficiency and speed asserted without reported benchmarks.

evidence: Sign-symmetry and feedback alignment on ImageNet (ResNet-18, AlexNet) and MS COCO (RetinaNet); SS approaches BP

evidence: Unspecified recent text and image generative models; viability demonstration; theoretical grounding for fingerprint amplification

evidence: Two recent self-supervised algorithms; unspecified datasets; gains in performance and convergence; affine beats homography

evidence: Proof for linear autoencoders; non-linear autoencoders on unspecified tabular and real-world image data reconstruct anomalies

evidence: Few-shot regression and classification; Omniglot, mini-ImageNet, Augmented Omniglot

evidence: GoodNews, VisualNews, WikiText; perplexity 4-5 points better than base; qualitative; human quality annotation; detector analysis

evidence: Unspecified uni- and multi-modal benchmarks; vs MIM methods; CLIP enhancement; zero-shot without image-text pairs

evidence: none reported

evidence: Unspecified experiments; outperforms state-of-the-art approaches
